extension.description: Live two-way sync between the Power Apps Studio formula bar (browser) and VS Code. Unofficial, not affiliated with Microsoft.
command.goToProperty: Switch property of the current control…
command.expandTree: Expand everything in Studio and reload
command.exportApp: Export the whole app (formulas and errors)
setting.port: Local WebSocket port the browser extension connects to (127.0.0.1 only).
setting.followSelection: Open the formula of the control/property selected in Power Apps Studio automatically.
setting.navigateOnEdit: When you edit a formula that is not the one shown in Studio, switch Studio to it before writing (instead of refusing the edit).
setting.singleTab: Keep a single formula tab: switching control/property in Studio closes the previous formula tab (pinned tabs are kept).
setting.mirrorFolder: Workspace folder on disk, so you and tools that work on real files (e.g. an AI assistant) can read and edit the app. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Writes `<Control>/<Control>.<Property>.fx`, `_app.json` (every control: type, screen, properties, formula files), `_state.json` (connection, selection, Studio errors, results of disk edits) and a `CLAUDE.md` guide. The folder git-ignores itself. Empty = disabled.
setting.exportOnConnect: When Studio connects, read every formula of the app (Studio's "Copy code" YAML of each screen, no navigation) into the workspace folder, plus the app-wide formula errors.
setting.syncFromDisk: Send a `.fx` file of the workspace folder (`#powerappsBridge.mirrorFolder#`) to Studio when it is saved, by you or by a tool. Off = the folder is a read-only copy.
setting.loadFullTree: When Studio connects, load **every** control of the app (Studio's tree view is expanded and scrolled briefly, then put back as it was). Off = only the rows visible in Studio's tree view.
setting.lint: Report in the Problems panel the variables, collections and named formulas that are never read, and the hidden controls that are never referenced (also written to `_lint.json` in the workspace folder).
setting.formatWidth: Target line width of Power Fx formatting (Shift+Alt+F).
walkthrough.title: Get started with Power Apps X VS Code
walkthrough.description: Edit Power Apps Studio formulas from VS Code, live.
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect Power Apps Studio
walkthrough.connect.description:
Install the **Power Apps X VS Code** browser extension (Chrome, Edge or Firefox), then open your canvas app in edit mode in Studio. On the first connection, VS Code asks you to approve the browser extension: accept. The status bar then shows the selected control.
[Open Power Apps](https://make.powerapps.com/)
[Show log](command:powerappsBridge.showLog)
walkthrough.select.title: Select a control
walkthrough.select.description: Click a control in Studio: its formula opens in VS Code. Type in VS Code and Studio updates (and the other way round). Studio’s errors appear in the **Problems** panel.
walkthrough.preview.title: See the screen
walkthrough.preview.description:
The preview shows Studio’s current screen. Click an element to select it and open its formula, search for a control by name, switch screens.
[Open the preview](command:powerappsBridge.showPreview)
walkthrough.navigate.title: Navigate without the mouse
walkthrough.navigate.description:
Above each formula, the **breadcrumb** (Screen › … › Control · Property) is clickable: go up to a container or switch property.
**Ctrl+Alt+F**: search for a control. **Ctrl+Alt+P**: switch property. **Ctrl+Alt+G**: go to `Control.Property`.
[Search for a control](command:powerappsBridge.goToControl)
walkthrough.sidebar.title: Explore the app
walkthrough.sidebar.description:
The **Power Apps X VS Code** side bar has two views: **Application** (screens and controls, errors in red) and **Control**, the inspector of the selected control: where it sits, its actions and its properties with a preview of each formula. Type to filter, click to open.
[Open the side bar](command:workbench.view.extension.powerapps)
